instruction.name: xvmsub.w
instruction.description: Multiply 32-bit elements in `b` and `c`, subtract the low 32 bits of the product from elements in `a`, save the result in `dst`.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 4.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvmsub.w $xr0, $xr8, $xr16; xvmsub.w $xr1, $xr9, $xr17; xvmsub.w $xr2, $xr10, $xr18; xvmsub.w $xr3, $xr11, $xr19; xvmsub.w $xr4, $xr12, $xr20; xvmsub.w $xr5, $xr13, $xr21; xvmsub.w $xr6, $xr14, $xr22; xvmsub.w $xr7, $xr15, $xr23
